metadata.source: Regressed in this work from EO–H₂O VLE data of MacCormack and Chenier (1955), Gillespie et al. (1985), and Schilk and Hurd (1957) as reproduced by Huang et al. (2012), with atmospheric bubble-point data from Union Carbide (1973) as reproduced by Mello (2010), and γ^∞_{EO,H₂O}(298.15 K) from Sherman et al. (1996). Vapor fugacities calculated with Peng–Robinson and k12=-0.10 following Huang et al. (2012).
metadata.description: Water/ethylene oxide liquid-activity and vapor-EOS interaction regressions.
notes: NRTL and UNIQUAC describe the liquid phase; PR and SRK kij values describe vapor-phase fugacity corrections.
The component orientation is retained explicitly because all activity-model parameters are directional.
